no-restricted-syntax.message: Play video through NeramVideoPlayer (src/components/video). A bare <video> ships native controls, and the native scrubber is how a student drags past a checkpoint. It also offers Download and Picture in picture, which hand over the file.
Embed YouTube through NeramVideoPlayer (src/components/video) so the checkpoint gate, the watermark and the progress telemetry come with it.
Call Gemini through @neram/ai rather than building the URL by hand, so the call is metered and the budget guard can refuse it.

paths.name: @google/generative-ai
paths.message: Call Gemini through @neram/ai. It owns the model list, the fallback order, the per-feature Auto/Manual/Off switch and the token metering behind the AI usage panel. Six private copies of this SDK are how the app kept calling models Google had already shut down.
